audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer chart row read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia. All seven rows disagreed.
audit.why: Anivia has no escape, no egg until 6, an 11s rank-1 Flash Frost and 80-100 mana per cast, so the first four levels are Orianna's. At 6 Glacial Storm plus a 17s Crystallize zones the wave and Rebirth blanks the all-in, and that does not reverse on items.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved onto the content/packet values, each why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' — both an unsourced magnitude and the wrong champion. Level 6 is Anivia's spike here.
audit.why: Glacial Storm plus Rebirth is what flips the lane; Shockwave does not out-zone a Storm on a wave she has walled.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to Lost Chapter, her Glacial Storm flip, and the egg blanking your all-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Frostbite deals doubled damage to a target recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm. Nor was Crystallize's retreat-cut. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all, and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Every Anivia kill pattern is chill-then-Frostbite; sidestepping the slow-moving sphere removes the doubling, which is the single mechanical fact that decides whether an Orianna survives a step-up. Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7s, Frostbite 4s, Crystallize 17s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry explicit wait-for-X sequencing with those numbers; enemyWin states the doubling.
sources: brief.enemyKit Q/E/W cooldowns and Riot text

notes: All seven full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and packet; sides moved onto the content values with every why rewritten in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edits: win[N] already holds the target strings, so a before==after edit would be rejected. The packet flagged this matchup as having zero cooldown-sequencing cues — I added concrete wait-for-X lines in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d built on Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7s, Frostbite 4s and Crystallize 17s. Ratings left as found. Not asserted anywhere: whether Command: Shockwave's pull can drag a target through a Crystallize wall, and whether Rebirth's egg is targetable by Shockwave — neither is in the kit text and I would not guess at it.
